entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be routed to the correct department.
RETURNS! JUST GET ME A PERSON!
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support, my name is Alex. I can certainly help you today. May I start with your name and order number?
Yeah, the name is Sam Jones, order 7-4-Charlie-9-2. I need to return this piece of garbage jersey you sent me. This is unbelievable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase, Sam. I'm pulling up your order now. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's the wrong size! I ordered a large, which is what I always wear, and this thing is so tight I can barely breathe in it. I want an exchange for one that actually fits, and I want it now. This is ridiculous. I'm one step away from blasting you on every social media platform.

I completely understand your frustration with the sizing, and I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. Let me look at the details... I see you ordered the Aero Pro Jersey about 30 days ago. That's no problem at all. It's well within our 90-day return policy.
So you can do it? Don't give me the runaround.

Absolutely. I can process this exchange for you right away. I've already initiated the return for the jersey that was too tight and placed an order for the next size up. There will be no charge, of course.
Fine. Just make sure it gets here fast. I've already waited long enough.

I've taken care of that as well. I see you're one of our VIP members, and we truly value your loyalty. To apologize for the sizing issue, I've upgraded the shipping on your new jersey to complimentary overnight express. I've also waived the return shipping fee for the original item.
Overnight? Okay... well, that's better. That's what you should have done in the first place.
I agree, and we appreciate your patience. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid return label shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with, Sam?
No, that's it. Just make sure it shows up tomorrow.
It will. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we hope you enjoy the new jersey.
